footer.regLabel: Foreign patient referral agency registration no.
footer.patientRights: Notice on the protection of foreign patients' rights
footer.notice: Pibu is a service where an AI agent helps you contact and compare clinics. Doctors decide on diagnosis and whether a procedure is suitable.

landing.metaTitle: Your agent talks to Korean clinics for you
landing.metaDescription: Tell your agent what you want. It organizes your conditions, gathers quotes, checks prices, books and keeps your records.
landing.title: Your agent talks to Korean clinics for you
landing.lead: Tell your agent what you want. It organizes your conditions, asks clinics for quotes, checks the prices and handles the booking.

tell.title: Tell your agent
tell.body: Chat about what you want. Your agent turns it into a condition card with the procedure, amount, budget, area, language and dates.

compare.title: Your agent compares
compare.body: Your agent asks clinics for quotes, and the platform checks them against past payment records.

book.title: Choose, book and keep records
book.body: Compare the quotes and book. Your record after the visit also helps you time the next session.

care.consent: Your information goes to a clinic only within the scope you agreed to.
care.doctor: Doctors decide on diagnosis and whether a procedure suits you. Pibu does not provide medical care.
care.records: Price checks appear as a one-to-one answer to your own request, never as a public advertisement.

signup.title: Get started
signup.lead: Sign up with your email, or pick a demo account.
signup.emailHint: No email is sent in the demo.
signup.emailError: Check the format of the email address.
signup.demoLead: These are fictional people. Picking one switches the screens to their language.

ask.label: What would you like to have done?

locked.title: About clinic matching and booking
locked.body: Clinic matching and booking are available only to foreign nationals on a short stay. Procedure records and next-session reminders are fully available.

agent.greeting: Hello, I'm your Pibu agent. Tell me which procedure you'd like.
agent.askProcedure: Which procedure is it about? Pick one below or just type it.
agent.summary: Got it, {procedure}. I organized your conditions. Tap any item to change it.

locked.title: About clinic matching and booking
locked.body: Clinic matching and booking are available only to foreign nationals on a short stay. Procedure records and next-session reminders are available.

condition.title: Condition card
condition.hint: Tap an item to change it.
condition.amountNote: Usually {range}. The lowest amount is filled in.
condition.privacy: Only the procedure, amount, area, language and dates are sent to clinics. Your budget is not sent.

reference.title: Market payment records
reference.body: In {count} records from the last {days} days, the price is {p25}~{p75} per {unit} (median {p50}). This is a reference from past records, not a guaranteed price.

compare.title: Compare quotes
compare.caption: Quotes by clinic
compare.hint: You can change the order. Quotes that need attention are shown, never hidden.

mode.proxy: Pibu is answering for the clinic · reference price
mode.clinic: Answered by the clinic · confirmed price

warn.label: Note
warn.paidMore: Past customers paid more than quoted (average +{pct}% in the last 90 days)
warn.downtime: Recovery may not be over before you leave Korea

sheet.title: Confirm your booking request
sheet.name: Name
sheet.doctor: The clinic's doctor decides on diagnosis and whether the procedure suits you.

bookings.title: Booking details

statusNote.pending_clinic_clinic: The clinic is checking your booking. It will show here once confirmed.
statusNote.pending_clinic_proxy: Pibu is checking with the clinic by phone or message. It will show here once confirmed.
statusNote.completed: Your procedure record has been received.

info.title: Booking
info.priceNote: This is the quoted amount. You can record what you actually paid on the day of the procedure.

notes.title: Notes from the clinic
notes.empty: Instructions for your visit will arrive here once the booking is confirmed.

explain.title: What the clinic explains before the procedure
explain.diagnosis: The diagnosis, the treatment method and possible side effects
explain.contract: The terms of the treatment agreement
explain.doctor: The doctor decides on diagnosis and whether the procedure suits you. Pibu does not explain these on the clinic's behalf.

bookings.downtime: Recovery may not be over before you leave Korea.

actions.simulateNote: In the real service the clinic or Pibu operations confirm the booking.
actions.recordNote: After the procedure you can record what you paid and the amount you received.
